action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "=== tiles styles ==="; ls -la tiles/styles/
echo "=== mbtiles metadata ==="; docker run --rm -v /workspace/deployment/tiles/germany.mbtiles:/g.mbtiles --entrypoint sh maptiler/tileserver-gl:v5.6.0 -c "ls -la /g.mbtiles" 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== check germany tile data via tilejson ==="; curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 "https://tiles.localhost/data/germany.json" | head -c 500
